user.title: Varmemodel
user.description: The house: outdoor temperature and weather. Add heat sources and rooms afterwards as sub-entries of the integration.

data.name: Name
data.indoor_temps: Room temperatures (only if you don't add rooms)
data.window_days: Days of data used for calibration
data.price_attribute: Price: attribute holding the list (empty = auto)

data_description.weather: E.g. Met.no. Wind, direction, cloud cover and UV are stored hourly so the effect of wind and sun can be calibrated.
data_description.indoor_temps: Otherwise the indoor temperature is the average of the rooms included in the plan.
data_description.block_entity: E.g. a zone schedule. Format: "HOURINDEX|codes" (hours since 1970 UTC, one code per hour) or a list with time and value.
data_description.price_entity: The price should include tariffs. The list needs time (start/t/time) and price (el/value/price) per hour or quarter.
data_description.measures_calendar: Each event is a measure (e.g. sealing). Heat loss is computed before and after its date.
data_description.plant_room: An unheated room (basement/utility room) warmed only by losses from the heating installation. Its loss to the ground is waste heat counted by the heat meter, so it is subtracted before the house heat loss is fitted, and the plan adds it to the demand.
data_description.plant_room_loss: Fixed heat loss of that room to the ground and outside (U·A of walls, floor and door). Kept fixed because it cannot be separated from the house heat loss with little data; a free fit is shown as diagnostics.
data_description.ground_temp: Typical ground temperature at basement depth (about 8–10 °C in Northern Europe).

data.flow_target: Flow target (entity Varmemodel writes the flow target to, e.g. the heat pump's climate in heat mode)
data.onoff_target: On/off target (climate Varmemodel switches to heat / off)

data_description.heat_energy: Without it COP, heat loss and emission cannot be calibrated.
data_description.compressor: Used for full running hours, starts and splitting heat between rooms.
data_description.dhw: Hours with hot water are excluded from space heating.
data_description.electricity_backup: Used for hours where the main meter has no data, e.g. before it was installed. Scaled automatically to the main meter using the hours where both have data.
data_description.flow_target: Flow target (entity Varmemodel writes the flow target to, e.g. the heat pump's climate in heat mode)
data_description.onoff_target: On/off target (climate Varmemodel switches to heat / off)

data.climate: Climate entity (control; found automatically on the unit's device)
data.assist_fan: Distribution fan (optional: heat is learned separately with it on and off)
data.el_power: Electric power (optional: W per ladder step is learned from it; energy meters are too coarse)

data_description.electricity_energy: Without a heat meter the rooms learn how many degrees they get per kWh of electricity.
data_description.electricity_backup: Used for hours where the main meter has no data, e.g. before it was installed. Scaled automatically to the main meter using the hours where both have data.

data_description.minimum_entity: E.g. an input_number with the lowest comfort temperature.
data_description.valve: On/open = the room receives heat from the hydronic source.
data_description.loop_weight: 1 = normal. A room with twice the loop length: 2.
data_description.in_plan: Off = shown and learned, but not considered by the plan (e.g. a basement).
data_description.neighbours: Temperature sensors in adjacent zones, e.g. the basement or a stairwell. The model learns how much heat flows between them.
data_description.heat_source: The heat source controlled by the room's thermostat or valve, which heats it directly. Empty = the room learns from all sources.
data_description.extra_sources: Sources that also heat the room directly. The room only learns from its own and these sources – heat from other rooms is learned via neighbouring zones. Sources that run at the same times cannot be separated by data alone.
data_description.maximum: Air-to-air plan: never heats the room above this.

missing_room.title: {name}: no measurement since {since}
missing_room.description: The temperature sensor {entity} has not reported a value since {since}. The plan and the recommended control now use the room's forecast, calculated from the last measurement with the heat actually delivered. Check the sensor (battery, connection or cloud service). This message disappears when the sensor measures again.

missing_room_unplanned.title: {name}: no measurement since {since}
missing_room_unplanned.description: The temperature sensor {entity} has not reported a value since {since}, and the room cannot be forecast (no earlier measurement or no room model yet). The room is left out of the plan until it measures again. Check the sensor (battery, connection or cloud service).

missing_outdoor.title: Outdoor sensor: no measurement since {since}
missing_outdoor.description: The outdoor sensor {entity} has not reported a value since {since}. The plan uses the weather forecast for the current hour. Check the sensor. This message disappears when the sensor measures again.
